front: What are the four forces on an aeroplane?
back: Lift (L), weight (W/G), thrust (T), drag (D).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Four forces</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LIFT ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>THRUST →</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WEIGHT ↓</text></svg>
tip: Mnemonic: Lift up, weight down; thrust forward, drag back.

front: In straight, level, unaccelerated flight, which forces balance?
back: L = W; T = D. This is ERHV.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Level-flight balance</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L = W</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>T = D</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ERHV</text></svg>

front: In which directions does static pressure act?
back: In **all directions**.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Static pressure</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STATIC</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↖ ↑ ↗</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>← • →</text></svg>

front: What is dynamic pressure?
back: q = ½ρV²; pressure associated with airflow speed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Dynamic pressure</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>q = ½ρV²</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>density ρ</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed V</text></svg>

front: State Bernoulli’s pressure relation for steady, frictionless, incompressible flow.
back: p_total = p_static + q. Higher flow speed means lower static pressure.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Bernoulli</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TOTAL</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STATIC + q</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed ↑</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>static ↓</text></svg>

front: What pressure pattern produces positive lift on a conventional aerofoil?
back: Lower pressure above (extrados), higher pressure below (intrados); both contribute.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Pressure over a wing</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LOW pressure</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AEROFOIL</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>HIGH pressure</text></svg>

front: Is the 70% upper-surface / 30% lower-surface lift split universal?
back: No. It is an approximate teaching model, not a fixed ratio.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Lift generation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>~70% above</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>teaching model</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>~30% below</text></svg>
tip: Do not treat the split as a universal law.

front: Define lift and drag by direction.
back: Lift is perpendicular to relative airflow; drag is parallel and opposite it.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Lift and drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>relative</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>airflow →</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LIFT ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>DRAG ←</text></svg>

front: What is chord?
back: The straight line joining the leading edge to the trailing edge.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerofoil chord</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LEADING</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CHORD</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TRAILING</text></svg>

front: What is the mean camber line?
back: The midline between the upper and lower aerofoil surfaces.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerofoil geometry</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>UPPER surface</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>MEAN CAMBER</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LOWER surface</text></svg>

front: What is camber?
back: The curvature of the mean camber line.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Camber</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>straight chord</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>curved mean</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>camber</text></svg>

front: Which are extrados and intrados?
back: Extrados = upper surface; intrados = lower surface.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerofoil surfaces</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>EXTRADOS</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AEROFOIL</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>INTRADOS</text></svg>

front: How is aerofoil thickness measured?
back: Perpendicular to the chord, between upper and lower surfaces.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Thickness</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>upper</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↕ thickness</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>lower</text></svg>

front: What angle is angle of attack (α)?
back: Angle between chord and relative airflow.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Angle of attack</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CHORD</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>α</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AIRFLOW</text></svg>
tip: Bank figure PFA-003: α is not pitch attitude.

front: What is angle of incidence?
back: Fixed installation angle between wing chord and aircraft longitudinal axis.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Incidence vs AoA</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CHORD</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>INCIDENCE</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FUSELAGE AXIS</text></svg>

front: Which way does relative airflow point?
back: Opposite the aircraft flight path. Pitch attitude is not angle of attack.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Relative airflow</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flight path →</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>aircraft →</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>airflow ←</text></svg>

front: Give both formulas for wing aspect ratio.
back: AR = span / mean chord = b²/S.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aspect ratio</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AR = b / c̄</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AR = b² / S</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>high AR ↓ Di</text></svg>

front: A wing has span 10 m and area 12.5 m². Find AR.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AR calculation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>b = 10 m</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>S = 12.5 m²</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AR = 8</text></svg>

front: What happens at the stagnation point?
back: Local flow speed is zero; streamlines divide over and under the aerofoil.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stagnation point</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed = 0</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STAGNATION</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flow divides</text></svg>

front: As angle of attack increases, which way does the stagnation point move?
back: Down the leading edge.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stagnation movement</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>α increases</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LEADING EDGE</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>point moves ↓</text></svg>

front: Where is the laminar boundary layer found?
back: From the stagnation point to the transition point, typically near the forward upper surface.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Boundary layer</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STAGNATION</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LAMINAR</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TRANSITION</text></svg>

front: Compare laminar and turbulent boundary layers.
back: Laminar: thinner, lower skin-friction drag; separates sooner. Turbulent: thicker, more friction, stays attached to higher AoA.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Boundary layers</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LAMINAR</text><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>thin, low</text><text x='54' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>friction</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TRANSITION</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TURBULENT</text><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>attached</text><text x='264' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>longer</text></svg>

front: What is the transition point?
back: Where the boundary layer changes from laminar to turbulent.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Transition</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LAMINAR</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TRANSITION</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TURBULENT</text></svg>

front: What is flow separation?
back: The boundary layer no longer follows the aerofoil surface; major separation is associated with stall.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Separation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ATTACHED</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>separation</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STALL</text></svg>

front: Define centre of pressure (CP).
back: The point on the chord where the resultant aerodynamic force is treated as acting.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Centre of pressure</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AEROFOIL</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>resultant</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>force</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP on chord</text></svg>

front: How does CP move on a positively cambered profile as AoA increases before critical AoA?
back: It moves forward, toward the leading edge.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP movement</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>α ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP moves</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>forward</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>critical α</text></svg>

front: What happens to CP when AoA decreases on a positively cambered profile?
back: It moves aft, toward the trailing edge.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP movement</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>α ↓</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP moves aft</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TRAILING EDGE</text></svg>

front: What may CP do near or after stall?
back: Pressure distribution changes abruptly; CP may move aft and pitch the nose down.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP near stall</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STALL</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>pressure</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>shifts</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP aft ↓ nose</text></svg>

front: Is CP at 25% chord for every aerofoil?
back: No. A symmetric bi-convex profile is taught as near 25%; do not generalise to every cambered profile.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CP position</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>symmetric</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>~25% chord</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>not universal</text></svg>

front: Write the lift equation and define its variables.
back: L = ½ρV²SCL = qSCL. ρ=density; V=TAS; S=wing area; CL=lift coefficient.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Lift equation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>q = ½ρV²</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L = q S CL</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>units matter</text></svg>

front: Calculate lift: ρ=1.225 kg/m³, V=50 m/s, S=16 m², CL=0.80.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Worked lift</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ρ,V → q</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>q = 1531 Pa</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L = 19,600 N</text></svg>

front: With CL etc. fixed, what happens to lift if speed doubles or triples?
back: Doubling V → 4× lift; tripling V → 9× lift (square law).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Square law</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V ×2</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L ×4</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V ×3 → L ×9</text></svg>

front: In level flight, does doubling speed normally quadruple lift?
back: Not necessarily: pilot/configuration changes CL so lift balances weight. Square law assumes CL and other values fixed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Lift scaling</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CL adjusted</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L = W</text></svg>
tip: Respect “all else constant” in exam calculations.

front: Write the drag equation.
back: D = ½ρV²SCD = qSCD. CD is dimensionless.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Drag equation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>q = ½ρV²</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>D = q S CD</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CD</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>dimensionless</text></svg>

front: Calculate drag: ρ=1.225, V=40 m/s, S=16 m², CD=0.040.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Worked drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>q = 980 Pa</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>S = 16 m²</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>D = 627.2 N</text></svg>

front: At fixed density, area and CD, what happens to parasite drag if speed doubles?
back: It increases approximately fourfold: D ∝ V².
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Parasite drag scaling</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V ×2</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>D ∝ V²</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>D ×4</text></svg>

front: What makes up total drag?
back: Total drag = induced drag + parasite drag.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Total drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TOTAL DRAG</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>INDUCED</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>+ PARASITE</text></svg>

front: Name the three components of parasite drag.
back: Form/pressure drag + skin-friction drag + interference drag.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Parasite drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FORM</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>SKIN FRICTION</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>INTERFERENCE</text></svg>

front: Where is interference drag prominent?
back: Where component airflow meets, especially at the wing/fuselage root. It is already part of parasite drag.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Interference drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WING</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>junction</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>INTERFERENCE</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FUSELAGE</text></svg>
tip: Do not add interference twice to total drag.

front: What causes induced drag?
back: Lift-related tip vortices and downwash, produced as high-pressure lower-surface air leaks around the tips.

front: When do wingtip vortices begin?
back: When the wing generates lift (in the bank answer, during rotation/lift generation).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Vortex onset</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>NO lift</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rotation</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LIFT →</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>vortices</text></svg>

front: How does induced drag change with airspeed in steady level cruise?
back: It decreases as airspeed increases; it rises as speed decreases.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Induced drag trend</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>induced drag ↓</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed ↓ → Di ↑</text></svg>

front: How does aspect ratio affect induced drag?
back: Higher AR reduces induced drag; low AR increases it.
