front: Which listed spanwise lift distribution has the lowest induced drag?
back: Elliptical distribution.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Lift distribution</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ELLIPTICAL</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>best</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>distribution</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>least Di</text></svg>

front: What do winglets do?
back: Weaken tip-vortex effects and reduce induced drag; they do not eliminate it.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Winglet effect</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>wingtip</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WINGLET</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>weaker vortex</text></svg>

front: During a steady level-cruise speed increase, what happens to parasite and induced drag?
back: Parasite drag increases; induced drag decreases.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Drag vs speed</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>parasite ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>induced ↓</text></svg>

front: At what condition is total drag minimum in the standard exam model?
back: When induced drag equals parasite drag; this is also the best L/D / best-glide condition in the simplified polar.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Minimum drag</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Di = Dp</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TOTAL minimum</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>best L/D</text></svg>

front: Can CD be negative?
back: No. It has a non-negative minimum.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Drag coefficient</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CD</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>≥ 0</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>non-negative</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>minimum</text></svg>

front: What is ground effect?
back: Near the surface: weaker tip-vortex/downwash effects, less induced drag, more effective lift.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Ground effect</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>near ground</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Di ↓</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>effective lift</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↑</text></svg>

front: What practical effect can ground effect cause after flare?
back: The aircraft may float; parasite drag does not disappear.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Ground effect</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flare</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ground effect</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FLOAT</text></svg>
tip: Ground effect is not “all drag disappears.”

front: Define wing loading.
back: Weight divided by wing area: W/S, not S/W.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Wing loading</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WEIGHT W</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>÷ area S</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>W/S</text></svg>

front: Find wing loading for W=10,000 N and S=16 m².
back: W/S = 10,000/16 = **625 N/m²**. For mass data, first calculate W=mg.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Wing loading calculation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>10,000 N</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>÷ 16 m²</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>625 N/m²</text></svg>

front: If an aircraft mass is given, how do you obtain weight for W/S?
back: Calculate W = mg first; then divide by wing area. Some tables quote mass/area in kg/m² instead.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Mass to wing loading</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>mass m</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>W = m g</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>divide by S</text></svg>

front: What is finesse / glide ratio?
back: L/D = CL/CD = horizontal distance ÷ height lost in still air at the appropriate glide condition.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Finesse</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L / D</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>distance →</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>height ↓</text></svg>

front: What does finesse 8 mean?
back: About 8 units forward for each 1 unit of height lost, in still air.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Glide ratio</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>height 1</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>glide</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>distance 8</text></svg>

front: Finesse 8.8, height above landing field 6,000 ft. Estimate range in NM.
back: Range = 8.8×6,000 = 52,800 ft; ÷6,076 = **8.69 NM**, ignoring wind/margins.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Glide range</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>6,000 ft × 8.8</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>52,800 ft</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>≈ 8.69 NM</text></svg>

front: Which height is used to calculate glide range?
back: Height above the intended landing point, not altitude above sea level.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Glide calculation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ALTITUDE</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>not reference</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>HEIGHT above</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>field</text></svg>
tip: Check chart units and reference height.

front: In the PFA-008 polar, what are the axes?
back: Horizontal: CD. Vertical: CL.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerofoil polar</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↑ CL</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>POLAR</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CD →</text></svg>

front: What does the tangent from origin to the polar identify?
back: Maximum CL/CD, the best-glide angle / maximum finesse (point 4).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Best-glide polar</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>origin</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tangent</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>max CL/CD</text></svg>

front: In PFA-008, identify points 1, 2 and 3.
back: 1 = inverted flight; 2 = near zero lift; 3 = fast flight (small AoA).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Polar points 1–3</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>1 inverted</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>2 zero lift</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>3 fast</text></svg>

front: In PFA-008, identify points 4, 5 and 6.
back: 4 = maximum finesse; 5 = slow flight/high AoA; 6 = post-stall.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Polar points 4–6</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>4 best glide</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>5 slow</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>6 post-stall</text></svg>
tip: Point 5 is not the stall; point 6 is post-stall.

front: What defines a stall?
back: Exceeding the critical angle of attack; it can occur at any speed, attitude or flight phase.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall condition</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AoA ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>critical AoA</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STALL</text></svg>

front: What happens to lift and drag as a stall develops?
back: Beyond critical AoA, separation causes lift/CL to fall abruptly while drag rises.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall curve</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>critical AoA</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>lift ↓</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>abruptly</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>drag ↑</text></svg>

front: Does aircraft weight change critical AoA?
back: No. Critical AoA is aerofoil/configuration-specific, not changed merely by weight or CG position.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Critical angle</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>weight changes</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stall speed</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>not critical α</text></svg>

front: Give the stall-speed relationship from lift at stall.
back: Vs = √[2W/(ρSCLmax)]. CLmax depends on aerofoil/configuration.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall-speed equation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>W ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Vs ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CLmax matters</text></svg>

front: For the same aircraft/configuration/density, how does Vs vary with weight?
back: Vs₂/Vs₁ = √(W₂/W₁). Higher weight → higher stall speed.

front: What does flap extension normally do to stall speed?
back: Increases CLmax, normally lowering stall speed for that configuration; drag increases.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Flaps and stall</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FLAPS</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CLmax ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Vs ↓</text></svg>

front: Does lower air density reduce indicated stall speed?
back: Not appreciably: IAS tracks dynamic pressure. Lower density increases the true speed needed for the same dynamic pressure.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Density and speed</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>density ↓</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>TAS at stall ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>IAS ~ similar</text></svg>

front: Which change decreases stall speed in the bank’s question: lower density, lower altitude, weight decrease, or higher load factor?
back: Decreasing weight.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall-speed exam trap</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>weight ↓</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Vs ↓</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>n ↑ → Vs ↑</text></svg>
tip: Do not confuse indicated and true stall speed.

front: When should a typical stall warning activate?
back: Just before the stall / Vs; it is a warning, not a guaranteed-time detector.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall warning</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>approaching Vs</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WARNING</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stall</text></svg>

front: What often triggers a vane/horn stall warning?
back: A local airflow / stagnation-point change.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Warning sensor</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>local flow</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stagnation</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>change</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>horn / vane</text></svg>

front: Name common stall clues.
back: Warning/buffet, low IAS, sluggish controls, possible high nose attitude and wing drop.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall clues</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>warning /</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>buffet</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>low IAS</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>sluggish /</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>wing drop</text></svg>

front: What is the first recovery priority from a stall?
back: Reduce AoA (unload); then add suitable power, level wings with coordinated controls as responsive, and recover within limits.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall recovery</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>REDUCE AoA</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>power as</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>needed</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>recover within</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>limits</text></svg>
tip: Use the aircraft POH/AFM and instructor procedure.

front: Why is aerofoil icing dangerous?
back: Changes shape, adds weight/drag and can cause early separation; roughness can sharply degrade lift.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerofoil icing</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ICE</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>shape + weight</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>separation</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>early</text></svg>

front: Define load factor n.
back: n = lift / weight; in straight, level, unaccelerated flight n=1 (1 g).
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Load factor</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>LIFT</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>÷ WEIGHT</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>n = 1 straight</text></svg>

front: In a coordinated level turn, what provides the turn and what supports weight?
back: Horizontal lift component provides centripetal acceleration; vertical component balances weight. Total lift increases.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Turn forces</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>L tilted</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>horizontal →</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>turn</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>vertical →</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>weight</text></svg>

front: Give the coordinated level-turn formula for load factor.
back: n = 1/cosφ.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Bank and load</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>bank φ</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>n = 1 / cos φ</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>lift ↑</text></svg>

front: What are n at 30° and 60° bank?

front: Find n at 45° bank.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Load calculation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>cos 45°=.7071</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>reciprocal</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>n ≈ 1.414</text></svg>

front: How does load factor affect stall speed?
back: Vsₙ = Vs₁g√n. In a coordinated level turn, Vsφ = Vs₁g√(1/cosφ).
