front: Which may increase load factor in cruise without a commanded turn?
back: An upward gust; it can also increase AoA and trigger a stall near critical AoA.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Gust loading</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>upward gust</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>load n ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>AoA ↑</text></svg>

front: Distinguish a spin from a spiral dive.
back: Spin: stalled autorotation, low IAS, roll+yaw+nose-down. Spiral: both wings unstalled, steep tightening descent, IAS/loads rise.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin or spiral</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>SPIN</text><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stalled,</text><text x='54' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rotating</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>or</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>SPIRAL</text><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>unstalled,</text><text x='264' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed ↑</text></svg>

front: What condition can lead to a spin?
back: A stall plus sustained autorotation, often after an uncoordinated stall; one wing is more stalled.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin entry</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>uncoordinated</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>STALL</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>autorotation</text></svg>

front: How can a spin be prevented?
back: Maintain speed and coordination; avoid an uncoordinated stall. Stall prevention is spin prevention.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin prevention</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>coordination</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>prevent stall</text></svg>

front: What is the taught general developed-spin sequence?
back: Power idle; ailerons neutral; opposite rudder to stop rotation; elevator forward to unstall; neutralise when rotation stops; recover dive within limits.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin recovery</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>IDLE + neutral</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ailerons</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>opposite</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rudder</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>forward</text><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>elevator →</text><text x='264' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>recover</text></svg>
tip: Aircraft-specific POH/AFM procedure always takes precedence.

front: Why keep ailerons neutral during spin recovery?
back: Aileron into the rising wing can worsen AoA on the dropping/stalled wing; do not use opposite aileron as primary recovery.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin recovery control</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ailerons</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>neutral</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>avoid</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>worsening</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stalled wing</text></svg>

front: What restrictions apply to spin practice?
back: Use only an approved aircraft and instructor, with adequate height and briefing; many aircraft prohibit intentional spins.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Spin practice</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>approved</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>aircraft</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>instructor +</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>height</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>POH procedure</text></svg>

front: What does a trailing-edge flap do?
back: Increases camber; at same AoA raises CL and drag, generally lowers approach/stall speed and reduces L/D.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Trailing-edge flap</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FLAP down</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>camber + CL ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>drag ↑</text></svg>

front: What additional effect does a Fowler flap have?
back: It extends aft before deflecting down, increasing wing area and camber.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Fowler flap</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>FOWLER</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>extends aft</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>then deflects</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↓</text></svg>

front: How do slots/slats help at high AoA?
back: Energise upper-surface boundary layer, delay separation and permit higher usable AoA; generally less drag than a trailing-edge flap for this task.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Slat / slot</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>leading-edge</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>gap</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>energise flow</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>separation</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>delayed</text></svg>

front: What is the distinction between a fixed slot and a slat?
back: Slot = fixed passage; slat = movable leading-edge device that opens a slot.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Slot vs slat</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>SLOT</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>fixed gap</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>SLAT</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>movable</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>opens slot</text></svg>

front: What is geometric washout and why use it?
back: Physical wing twist reduces incidence toward the tip; root stalls first, preserving outboard aileron effectiveness.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Geometric washout</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>root incidence</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>twist outward</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tip stalls</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>later</text></svg>

front: What is aerodynamic washout?
back: A spanwise change in aerofoil section that gives the wing a washout effect without physical twist.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerodynamic washout</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>root section</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>spanwise</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>change</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tip section</text></svg>

front: What does a stall strip do?
back: Encourages inboard/root stall first to help preserve outboard aileron control.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stall strip</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>root stalls</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>first</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ailerons</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>retain control</text></svg>

front: What do vortex generators do?
back: Small vanes energise the boundary layer locally and delay separation.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Vortex generators</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>small vanes</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>energise layer</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>separation</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>delayed</text></svg>

front: What does wing dihedral do?
back: Improves lateral/roll stability in sideslip; anhedral reduces this effect.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Dihedral</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>sideslip</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>DIHEDRAL</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>restoring roll</text></svg>

front: Which feature generally reduces induced drag by weakening wingtip vortices?
back: Winglet.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Winglet</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>wingtip vortex</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>WINGLET</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>induced drag ↓</text></svg>

front: How does a right-roll aileron input work?
back: Right aileron up, left down; right wing lift rises relative to left.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aileron roll</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>right ↑</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>roll RIGHT</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>left ↓</text></svg>

front: What yaw may accompany a right roll input?
back: Initially yaw left (adverse yaw), because the down-aileron wing has greater drag. Coordinate with rudder.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Adverse yaw</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>roll RIGHT</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>yaw LEFT</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>adverse yaw</text></svg>

front: How does differential aileron reduce adverse yaw?
back: Upgoing aileron travels farther than downgoing, limiting drag on the down-aileron wing.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Differential aileron</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>upgoing</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>farther</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>down-going</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>less</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>adverse yaw ↓</text></svg>

front: How does a Frise aileron reduce adverse yaw?
back: The upgoing aileron nose protrudes into airflow, creating balancing drag.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Frise aileron</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>aileron up</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>nose protrudes</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>balancing drag</text></svg>

front: What does left rudder deflection primarily do?
back: Yaw the aircraft left about its vertical axis.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Rudder effect</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rudder LEFT</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>yaw LEFT</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>vertical axis</text></svg>

front: What does the slip/skid ball indicate, and how do you correct it?
back: Coordination (slip/skid), not bank angle; “step on the ball” with rudder toward the ball.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Turn coordination</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>ball displaced</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>step on ball</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rudder toward</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>it</text></svg>

front: Map the three body axes to rotation and primary control.
back: Longitudinal → roll/ailerons; lateral → pitch/elevator; vertical → yaw/rudder.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Axes and controls</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>longitudinal</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>roll</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>lateral</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>pitch</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>vertical</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>yaw</text></svg>

front: What is positive static stability?
back: Initial tendency to return toward the original condition after displacement.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Static stability</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>displaced</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>restoring</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tendency</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>original</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>condition</text></svg>

front: Contrast neutral and negative static stability.
back: Neutral: stays displaced. Negative: initially moves farther away.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Static stability types</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>NEUTRAL</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stays</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>NEGATIVE</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>moves away</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>initial</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>response</text></svg>

front: What does dynamic stability describe?
back: How motion/oscillation evolves over time: damped, constant or increasing.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Dynamic stability</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>disturbance</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>oscillation</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>damped / grows</text></svg>

front: Which features primarily support pitch, yaw and roll stability?
back: Horizontal tail: longitudinal/pitch; vertical tail: directional/yaw; dihedral: lateral/roll.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Stability features</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>horizontal</text><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tail</text><text x='54' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>pitch</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>vertical tail</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>yaw</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>dihedral</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>roll</text></svg>

front: What are general effects of forward CG?
back: Usually greater longitudinal stability and elevator/rotation force; too far forward can limit control authority.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Forward CG</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG forward</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stability ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rotation force</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>↑</text></svg>

front: What are general effects of aft CG?
back: Reduced pitch stability and recovery margin; more manoeuvrable but less forgiving.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aft CG</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG aft</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>stability ↓</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>recovery</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>margin ↓</text></svg>

front: How is CG kept within limits?
back: By correct loading per POH/AFM. Trim does not move CG.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG control</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>load correctly</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG within</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>limits</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>trim ≠ CG</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>shift</text></svg>

front: What does a forward CG generally require at take-off rotation?
back: More elevator deflection / force.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG and rotation</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG forward</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>elevator</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>demand ↑</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rotation</text></svg>

front: What is the primary effect of elevator?
back: Pitch about the lateral axis; nose-up input tends to increase AoA and reduce speed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Elevator</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>elevator</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>pitch</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>lateral axis</text></svg>

front: What is a secondary effect of rudder deflection?
back: Yaw can produce roll through differing wing speeds / dihedral effect.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Rudder secondary effect</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>rudder</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>yaw</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>roll may</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>follow</text></svg>

front: What does aerodynamic control balance do?
back: Reduces pilot control forces.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Aerodynamic balance</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>airflow</text><text x='54' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>balance</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>control force</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>reduced</text></svg>

front: What does mass/static control balance do?
back: Counterweights balance the control surface about its hinge to prevent flutter.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Mass balance</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>counterweight</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>hinge balance</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flutter</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>prevented</text></svg>

front: What is flutter, and what is a key risk?
back: Potentially destructive aeroelastic vibration; exceeding VNE risks flutter and structural damage.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Flutter hazard</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed > VNE</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flutter</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>structural</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>damage</text></svg>

front: What is the purpose of trim?
back: Relieve sustained control force; it does not initiate a manoeuvre or move CG.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Trim</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>trim tab</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>relieves force</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>CG unchanged</text></svg>

front: How does an elevator trim tab act?
back: Aerodynamically opposite the elevator’s desired effect. In the bank convention, tab up counters nose-up tendency; indicator says nose-down.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>Trim</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>nose tends up</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>tab UP</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>indicator</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>nose-down</text></svg>

front: Define VNE and the risk of exceeding it.
back: Never-exceed speed; do not exceed. Flutter and structural damage may result.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V-speeds</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>VNE</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>NEVER exceed</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>flutter /</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>damage</text></svg>

front: What is VNO?
back: Maximum normal-operation / normal operating speed.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V-speeds</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>VNO</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>maximum</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>normal</text><text x='264' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>operation</text></svg>

front: What does VA mean, and what is its limitation?
back: Manoeuvring speed per POH; it is not permission for abrupt, simultaneous full controls. Protection depends on weight/input.
visual: <svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 320 150'><path d='M8 0 H312 Q320 0 320 8 V142 Q320 150 312 150 H8 Q0 150 0 142 V8 Q0 0 8 0 Z' fill='#fdf6e3'/><text x='160' y='25' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='15' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>V-speeds</text><line x1='98' y1='91' x2='108' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M108 86 L115 91 L108 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><line x1='203' y1='91' x2='213' y2='91' stroke='#526273' stroke-width='2'/><path d='M213 86 L220 91 L213 96 Z' fill='#526273'/><path d='M18 59 H90 Q98 59 98 67 V115 Q98 123 90 123 H18 Q10 123 10 115 V67 Q10 59 18 59 Z' fill='#dceeff' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='54' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>VA</text><path d='M123 59 H195 Q203 59 203 67 V115 Q203 123 195 123 H123 Q115 123 115 115 V67 Q115 59 123 59 Z' fill='#dff3df' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='159' y='85' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>manoeuvring</text><text x='159' y='97' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>speed</text><path d='M228 59 H300 Q308 59 308 67 V115 Q308 123 300 123 H228 Q220 123 220 115 V67 Q220 59 228 59 Z' fill='#fff0d6' stroke='#263746' stroke-width='1.5'/><text x='264' y='79' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>not</text><text x='264' y='91' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>full-control</text><text x='264' y='103' text-anchor='middle' font-family='sans-serif' font-size='9.5' font-weight='bold' fill='#17212b'>licence</text></svg>

front: Define VFE, VLO and VLE.
back: VFE = max speed with flaps extended; VLO = max gear-operating speed; VLE = max speed with gear extended (often VLO<VLE).
